title: HydroSheaf: an auditable evidence-integration framework for groundwater age, connectivity and reaction inference under uncertainty
aim: Document how HydroSheaf was implemented and evaluate its bounded capabilities under independent controlled-synthetic truth and data-limited field measurements.
primary_question: Can HydroSheaf integrate connectivity, residence-time, reaction and kinetic evidence while calibrating uncertainty, representing model disagreement, abstaining when evidence is insufficient and producing reproducible decisions?
objectives: Describe the modular package and its auditable evidence contract.
Evaluate age, reaction and kinetic components against competence-matched specialist baselines.
Evaluate discrepancy-aware model averaging and truth-blind cost-adjusted next-measurement selection.
Audit the independent synthetic generators, controls, provenance and reproduction conditions.
Apply the workflow to real Ghanaian FieldData without treating it as field truth.
claim_boundary: parameter identification is abstained when structural confounding remains
